title: Watchdog timer
description: A RAII watchdog timer shall be provided to detect task hangs in safety-critical loops.

title: Safe-state transition
description: The system shall provide a scope-guard mechanism to ensure safe-state is engaged on unexpected exit paths.

title: Heartbeat monitor
description: A heartbeat monitor shall be provided to detect liveness failures in periodic tasks.

title: No raw new/delete
description: Smart pointers shall be used instead of raw new/delete to prevent memory leaks.

title: No goto
description: goto statements are prohibited to maintain structured control flow.

title: reinterpret_cast justification
description: All reinterpret_cast uses shall be justified with a fusa:unsafe annotation.

title: Safe-state before abort
description: abort()/exit() calls shall be preceded by a safe-state transition.

title: Thread-safe global access
description: All writes to shared global state shall be protected by a synchronisation primitive.

title: No unbounded loops
description: All loops shall have a deterministic termination condition or a fusa:bounded annotation.

title: Project configuration
description: A .fusa.json configuration file shall exist at the project root.

title: Cybersecurity static analysis
description: The tool shall scan C++ source for 20 CWE-mapped cybersecurity patterns per ISO 21434.

title: Test evidence collection
description: The tool shall execute ctest and capture results into .fusa-evidence.json.

title: Evidence bundle format
description: .fusa-evidence.json shall include generatedAt, cppVersion, results[], and summary.

title: Qualification test cases
description: The tool shall provide built-in positive and negative test cases for all engine rules.

title: Qualification report format
description: qualify-report.json shall include total/passed/failed counts and a SHA-256 integrity hash.

title: Isolated test execution
description: Each qualification test case shall run in its own isolated temporary directory.

title: SBOM generation
description: The tool shall generate an SBOM in SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD format from CMake dependencies.

title: Build provenance
description: The tool shall record build environment including VCS revision and platform.

title: Artifact manifest
description: The tool shall compute SHA-256 checksums for all evidence artifact files.

title: Evidence bundle packaging
description: The tool shall bundle all evidence files into audit-pack.zip with AUDIT-MANIFEST.json.

title: Audit manifest format
description: AUDIT-MANIFEST.json shall list each file with its SHA-256 digest and size.

title: TARA generation
description: The tool shall generate a Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment per ISO 21434 Chapter 9.

title: TARA output format
description: The TARA shall be written as tara.json and tara.md with risk ratings.

title: FMEA from source declarations
description: The tool shall generate a dFMEA by scanning class and function declarations.

title: FMEA output format
description: The FMEA shall be written as fmea.json and fmea.csv with RPN values.

title: GSN safety case generation
description: The tool shall generate a Goal Structuring Notation safety case argument.

title: Safety case output format
description: The safety case shall be written as safety-case.json and safety-case.mermaid.

title: SVG badge generation
description: The tool shall generate a Shields.io-compatible SVG status badge.

title: Badge rendering
description: The badge shall indicate pass/warn/fail status with error and warning counts.

title: Report comparison
description: The tool shall compare two JSON reports and categorise findings as introduced/resolved/unchanged.

title: Report loading
description: The tool shall load findings from JSON report files produced by cpfusa check.

title: Diff rendering
description: The diff output shall show introduced, resolved, and unchanged findings.

title: Key generation
description: The tool shall generate a 32-byte random HMAC key and write it as 64-char hex.

title: Artifact signing
description: The tool shall sign artifacts with HMAC-SHA256 and write the signature to <file>.sig.

title: Signature verification
description: The tool shall verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures in constant time to prevent timing attacks.

title: Git pre-commit hook
description: The tool shall install a pre-commit hook that runs cpfusa check --strict.
